normative_requirement: Declare which external source family and offline ingress mode a payload belongs to before native preparation, while preventing network, credential, trade, sizing or persistence authority from entering through the payload.
observed_code: Validates the interface as offline-only, rejects credential declarations, recursively rejects forbidden authority keys, and deep-copies accepted payload material.
conformance_disposition: Local validation and copy boundaries reflect the frozen intent, but market/options/calendar adapters do not consistently enter through this carrier, so it is not the authoritative composed ingress.
gate_c_action: Prove every admitted external family either enters through this contract or through an explicitly different source-owned contract; reject fabricated source identity and forbidden authority recursively.

behaviour: Raw market and options bundle decode
normative_requirement: Collect one already-obtained market snapshot and options surface into an upstream typed bundle while preserving source temporal truth before preparation.
observed_code: Selects explicit market/options sections when present; otherwise treats the full payload or selected price/DTE subset as the section; constructs RawBundleProvenance and requires timestamp or date truth.
conformance_disposition: Source temporal truth fails closed, but raw-capture identity and durable capture do not exist. Fallback section inference can blur source semantics.
gate_c_action: Require and preserve source/capture identity, test explicit section precedence, test that fallback inference cannot silently misclassify unrelated keys, and prove no cognition bypass.

normative_requirement: Provide a convenience adapter from a raw mapping to the first prepared runtime snapshot.
observed_code: Copies snapshot_id into the mapping, decodes it as an API raw bundle, prepares a dataset, returns primary_snapshot.
conformance_disposition: The adapter reaches preparation but does not validate through the declared external source interface and cannot establish provider substitution or source-issued identity.
gate_c_action: Prove the adapter composes the authoritative external-source contract and preserves identity/temporal lineage.

normative_requirement: Provide a convenience adapter from raw options material to a typed options-flow stage input.
observed_code: Decodes raw bundle, prepares the primary snapshot, then maps spot/front DTE/next DTE into OptionsFlowContextInput.
conformance_disposition: Typed missing-field behaviour exists, but source identity, observation time and surface version do not reach the options stage.
gate_c_action: Prove typed options payload identity/version/time carriage or explicitly define why the stage may consume only derived primitives.

normative_requirement: Load checked calendar/reference artefacts and their named layers without granting online mutation, candidate formation, trading or sizing authority.
observed_code: Rejects forbidden runtime-authority keys; types artefacts/layers; requires unique IDs and valid layer-to-artefact references.
conformance_disposition: The local importer is explicit and fail-closed. The exact intended business meaning and number of calendar layers are not fixed by code; the manifest accepts any unique layer set.
gate_c_action: Preserve current negative tests and add authoritative fixture(s) proving the adopted calendar layer model once that model is explicitly specified.

normative_requirement: Accept operator/API-created session and event records for bounded runtime calendar queries, separately from checked reference projection.
observed_code: Appends records to in-process repositories; queries events by overlap, symbol and materiality; sorts by proximity and materiality.
conformance_disposition: Context-only flags are explicit, but process-memory storage, no duplicate protection and separate reference/operational paths prevent one authoritative calendar truth.
gate_c_action: Prove duplicate/identity rules, separation from candidate/sizing authority, and one explicit composition between checked reference projection and operational query state.

behaviour: Raw signal family and market substrate carriers
normative_requirement: Represent raw or minimally derived market observations by signal family before preparation, without trade-decision side effects.
observed_code: Validates typed observation/snapshot structure, deep-copies list fields and rejects declared trade-decision side effects.
conformance_disposition: The carriers constrain local authority but are not the types consumed by raw_bundle_loader/runtime_preparer, so the intended family extension seam is not end-to-end.
gate_c_action: Prove a new signal family can be added through a registry/adapter without changing unrelated preparation or cognition, and preserve timestamp/source identity.

normative_requirement: Create a runtime-ready, detached snapshot from one or more raw bundles while retaining preparation lineage and explicit enrichment gaps.
observed_code: Combines market/options/provenance sections, aligns to explicit or minute-floored bar time, derives bounded features, records missing/failed optional enrichments.
conformance_disposition: Prepared state is detached and explicit about enrichment failures, but it remains a generic payload mapping and lacks mandatory identity/version fields.
gate_c_action: Define and prove the stable common envelope plus strongly typed payload contracts; require source/capture IDs and schema version without generic-dictionary drift.

normative_requirement: Translate one prepared snapshot into the typed primitives consumed by the serial cognitive stages.
observed_code: Maps temporal, regime and options-flow fields into three Pydantic contracts; records missing numeric fields and rejects invalid types.
conformance_disposition: Typed stage inputs are clear, but the bundle does not carry provenance/configuration versions needed to reconstruct why later decisions occurred.
gate_c_action: Prove mandatory bundle identity, source lineage and policy/config version carriage while preserving typed stage contracts.

normative_requirement: Carry outputs between deliberate runtime module boundaries after raw input and preparation, not redefine upstream raw material as packets.
observed_code: Builds DeskModulePacketV3 envelopes with module/grammar metadata, validation and lineage structures.
conformance_disposition: Typed carriage exists and correctly begins after preparation/at module seams, but default-generated authority identities and wall-clock packet metadata do not meet the frozen lineage/replay law.
gate_c_action: Require role-specific mandatory IDs, source artefact lineage and deterministic packet reproduction rules; test that pre-DMP inputs remain non-DMP.

normative_requirement: Resolve overlapping market, options and provenance fields into one prepared payload with predictable precedence.
observed_code: Creates market_spot_price and options_spot_price; chooses options spot as canonical spot when present; copies selected return, volatility, close and temporal keys by market→options→provenance precedence; normalises event windows.
conformance_disposition: Precedence is deterministic but implicit. Different source sections can be collapsed without field-level lineage or conflict reporting.
gate_c_action: Prove precedence and conflict behaviour, preserve source-section provenance per canonical field, and reject semantic collisions where silent choice is unsafe.

normative_requirement: Add simple deterministic runtime features while explicitly distinguishing missing optional inputs from failed derivations.
observed_code: Derives window_count/has_windows, minutes_to_next_event, DTE spread and NVDA return; records missing_optional_enrichments or failed_enrichments.
conformance_disposition: Missing and failed enrichments are truthfully separated, but formula/version lineage is insufficient for long-lived replay or safe future replacement.
gate_c_action: Prove derivation version, input provenance and deterministic replay for each material derived field.

normative_requirement: Convert prepared values into narrowly typed temporal, regime and options-flow inputs without letting downstream stages inspect the whole raw payload.
observed_code: Temporal mapper requires timestamp/date and validates windows/types; regime/options mappers cast selected numeric fields and enumerate missing fields.
conformance_disposition: Type and missing-field handling are clear; lineage/context versions disappear from two of three stage inputs.
gate_c_action: Preserve source/bundle identity and schema/policy versions without widening stage-specific payloads.

behaviour: Source, capture, domain and packet identity distinction
normative_requirement: Keep the identity of an upstream source artefact separate from repository capture, domain observation, prepared snapshot, runtime run and packet occurrence.
observed_code: Current code validates many local IDs but does not enforce one cross-surface origin/propagation model.
conformance_disposition: Local non-empty checks do not prove authoritative origin. Current paths can continue with optional or manufactured identity, contrary to fail-closed lineage law.
gate_c_action: Create an identifier-role matrix in tests: owner, mandatory/optional status, propagation and forbidden fabrication for every material ID.

normative_requirement: Explain how one prepared snapshot was formed from raw sections and which derived fields were added.
observed_code: Stores source_kind, transport, optional source_snapshot_id, source_sections, alignment_policy, runtime_bar_time and derived field names.
conformance_disposition: It truthfully describes preparation mechanics but cannot prove which original artefact bytes and policy versions produced the result.
gate_c_action: Require source artefact IDs/fingerprint and preparation policy/schema versions; prove detached copy and replay equivalence.

normative_requirement: Emit one packet per serial stage with ordered parent/dependency links and a common run/trace context.
observed_code: Derives deterministic packet IDs from stage name and source time; links previous packet and declared dependencies; adds derivedfrom and summary.
conformance_disposition: Parent/dependency structure is explicit, but packet occurrence and authoritative execution/source lineage are not replay-safe.
gate_c_action: Prove required sourceartifactids, supplied execution context IDs, deterministic domain outputs independent of emitted_at, and exact dependency semantics.

normative_requirement: Carry selected temporal/StageInput evidence into the independent Parallel Risk lane without giving the lane capital-sizing authority.
observed_code: Builds bootstrap packet, evaluates lane output, preserves parent/dependency/source artefact and input fingerprint fields when supplied.
conformance_disposition: The serial-to-PRL selection is explicit, but optional IDs and incomplete composition prevent one authoritative end-to-end lineage.
gate_c_action: Require input/parent/dependency/source IDs at admitted runtime boundaries and prove no serial outputs other than declared inputs influence the lane.

normative_requirement: Maintain reference calendar truth, operational event/session rows and context projections as separate concerns.
observed_code: Reference importer/projector is deterministic; operational repositories append/query process-memory rows; bounded SQLite also stores session_calendars separately.
conformance_disposition: The code separates checked reference import, projection, operational query and SQL fixtures, but does not establish their precedence, synchronisation or exact intended layer model.
gate_c_action: Before tests, confirm the authoritative calendar layer model; then prove owner, precedence, identity and substitution at each layer.

normative_requirement: Hold capital snapshots, positions, execution events, market observations, options-flow history, review packets and research logs behind repository-like APIs.
observed_code: Append/store deep copies, reject selected duplicates, return detached copies.
conformance_disposition: Tests prove local process-memory behaviour and copy semantics, not the normative durable-state/replay objective.
gate_c_action: Retain local contract tests but add restart/durable adapter contract tests only where the normative boundary requires durability; never label memory stores durable.

normative_requirement: Record policy observations produced by the Parallel Risk gateway without capital sizing.
observed_code: Builds a decision and appends it to module-global _RISK_POLICY_DECISIONS.
conformance_disposition: The lane owns process-global mutable history rather than an injected state owner, undermining isolation, replay and concurrent run separation.
gate_c_action: Prove injected repository ownership, run/session identity, duplicate law and isolation between service instances/tests.

normative_requirement: Expose small in-process lists of veto/risk-block events through the API shell.
observed_code: Appends plain dictionaries to HttpApp instance lists.
conformance_disposition: Acceptable only as explicitly non-authoritative alpha shell state; current API class also owns too many unrelated responsibilities.
gate_c_action: Either remove from admitted architecture or define typed owner/contract; test that API storage cannot influence domain decisions directly.

normative_requirement: Provide a simple file-backed store for dev intraday bars, option snapshots and session calendars.
observed_code: Creates three tables, seeds deterministic demo data, lists rows.
conformance_disposition: The store is durable but narrow and disconnected from most runtime owners; calling the wider system durable would be false.
gate_c_action: Prove only the intended bounded SQL contract; define separate repository ports before connecting material runtime state.

normative_requirement: Offer repository APIs for alpha development while keeping domain code separate from eventual storage technology.
observed_code: Stores deep copies in dicts/lists and enforces local duplicate rules.
conformance_disposition: The abstraction seam is useful, but current tests and names sometimes imply persistence without proving restart survival.
gate_c_action: Create shared repository contract tests that run against memory and future durable adapters, explicitly separating persistence semantics from interface semantics.

normative_requirement: Record receipts/execution events for later review without mutating trading decisions.
observed_code: Append with duplicate checks and return copies; current implementations are in memory.
conformance_disposition: Receipts can be recorded, but they do not prove that all material state changes were atomically captured or are replayable after restart.
gate_c_action: Prove receipt sequencing, idempotency and consistency with state changes at the smallest admitted transaction boundary.

normative_requirement: Convert source observation time and scheduled event windows into a coarse session state, active event tags and next-event time.
observed_code: Converts UTC observation to supplied timezone; applies fixed clock thresholds; tags active windows; selects earliest future window if next event absent.
conformance_disposition: Source-time and scheduled-window handling are explicit; phase logic is coarse and clock-only.
gate_c_action: Preserve current source-time/timezone tests and add policy/version tests for the accepted temporal classifier.

normative_requirement: Represent the human trader’s evolving sense of market phase, where opening/HFT dominance decays according to observed liquidity, volume, spread and microstructure signals rather than at a magical fixed time.
normative_refs: Direct user architecture instruction 2026-07-17; frozen surfaces 5.2, 5.4, 5.7; detailed algorithm remains absent from normative corpus
test_evidence: Current temporal tests cover fixed thresholds; no admitted test proves signal-driven phase transition.
observed_code: Expected: stateful/evidence-based phase transition; current code: fixed pre_open/opening/mid_session/closing/post_close thresholds at 09:30, 10:30, 15:30 and 16:00.
conformance_disposition: Current code can truthfully report a coarse clock bucket but cannot claim to emulate signal-informed intraday phase cognition.
gate_c_action: PREREQUISITE: create a numbered normative addendum defining phase inputs, transition semantics, state/history, versioning and graceful degradation; then write signal-path and anti-clock-cutoff tests.

normative_requirement: Summarise NVDA versus NQ movement and VIX into a bounded volatility/cross-asset regime context.
observed_code: Computes absolute NVDA–NQ difference; classifies high_volatility at VIX>=30, divergent at dispersion>=2, normal when complete, otherwise unknown; records reasons.
conformance_disposition: The algorithm is explicit and honest but far narrower than tier-one trader regime cognition; no version/history context is carried.
gate_c_action: Prove current bounded classifier exactly, unknown handling and policy-version carriage; do not inflate scope until normative requirements expand.

normative_requirement: Provide a bounded options context from spot and front/next expiry distance.
observed_code: Classifies DTE ordering as contango/backwardation/flat, marks gamma active for positive spot, leaves skew unknown.
conformance_disposition: The code clearly exposes limited current behaviour and unknown skew; the name “options flow” is broader than the actual DTE/spot logic.
gate_c_action: Prove honest unknowns and isolation; future richer flow must enter through versioned contracts rather than changing unrelated stages.

normative_requirement: Translate market regime into a bounded stand-down/permit posture while applying governed posture coefficient modifiers.
observed_code: Loads baseline coefficient values, builds/resolves modifier packet, evaluates posture permission, attaches effective coefficient lineage to local envelope.
conformance_disposition: Modifier application is explicit, but runtime composition usually supplies no active modifiers and the output does not carry one immutable authority-document version.
gate_c_action: Prove baseline/effective values, modifier precedence, immutable authority version/fingerprint and no policy smuggling.

normative_requirement: Load named coefficient surfaces and apply only explicitly admitted modifier policies at their owning stage.
observed_code: Validates records/policies, rejects duplicates/unknown IDs, starts from baseline values and applies explicit effects only to admitted surfaces.
conformance_disposition: The local authority boundary is strong, but orchestrated use, version carriage and execution-side modifiers are incomplete.
gate_c_action: Prove substitution of coefficient documents/policies without changing consumers, carry document fingerprint/version, and keep execution modifiers fail-closed until admitted.

normative_requirement: Run one deterministic alpha serial pass through temporal, regime, options, posture, playbook eligibility and execution expression.
observed_code: Evaluates stages in fixed order; eligibility receives an empty candidate family list; builds six packets and a stage-local handoff; non-valid mappings instead return structural executed/missing-stage inspection.
conformance_disposition: Tests prove both paths locally, but invalid governed input becomes a structural receipt rather than failing closed; the active path cannot select any playbook because candidate_family_ids is hard-coded empty.
gate_c_action: Separate explicit inspection API from governed run_once; fail closed on invalid execution input; supply candidate families through an owned contract; make domain replay independent of wall clock.

normative_requirement: Represent a replaceable set of named strategy/playbook definitions, setup variants, eligibility constraints and selection metadata without hidden capital or broker authority.
observed_code: Validates IDs, uniqueness and forbidden authority keys; loads enabled playbooks and emits metadata receipts/fingerprints.
conformance_disposition: Definitions are modular and authority-smuggling is rejected, but adding ten playbooks is only easy at registry level; runtime selection remains disconnected.
gate_c_action: Prove registry-driven composition: add/remove a playbook without editing orchestrator/eligibility/domain code, preserve stable contract and reject unknown/disabled definitions.

normative_requirement: Filter candidate playbook families through posture permission and registry constraints.
observed_code: If posture does not permit, returns no active families; otherwise compiles/filters candidates. In the orchestrator, candidate_family_ids is always empty.
conformance_disposition: Eligibility can be tested in isolation, but the composed serial path never supplies a candidate family and therefore never exercises registry-driven strategy selection.
gate_c_action: Prove candidate-family origin, registry version and composed selection; preserve stand-down when posture blocks or candidate set is empty.

normative_requirement: Turn eligible playbook families into a bounded candidate expression and review-oriented lifecycle plan, without broker execution.
observed_code: Selects first active family as lead, outputs enter/stand_down scaling token and ready flag; lifecycle plan is stand_down or prepare_candidate_review.
conformance_disposition: The output is explicitly bounded, but “enter” and lead selection are simplistic and not tied to playbook definitions or candidate identity.
gate_c_action: Prove deterministic lead-selection authority, candidate identity, no broker/capital authority, and lifecycle extension through contracts.

normative_requirement: Independently describe fragility, freshness, missing signals, event proximity and environmental risk as context—not as a trading play or capital-sizing decision.
observed_code: Builds bootstrap DMP packet, assesses environment, aggregates families, assembles risk atoms/minute profile and emits descriptive packet; optional candidate semantic enrichment.
conformance_disposition: Many local semantics are well tested, but the lane is not composed into one authoritative serial→final-risk→capital run and global mutable decisions violate isolation.
gate_c_action: Partition tests by normative atom/family semantics, require configuration/version/lineage, prove independence from sizing/playbook authority and replace global state.

behaviour: Final risk overlay and terminal join
normative_requirement: Apply a final bounded risk gate after the serial execution expression.
observed_code: If no lead playbook, overlay returns stand_down; otherwise continue. Terminal join returns stand_down/confidence 0 or proceed/confidence 1.
conformance_disposition: The final join does not actually join the Parallel Risk product; it only checks whether a lead playbook exists.
gate_c_action: Define and prove the actual join contract: required PRL packet identity, hard/caution semantics, precedence, missing-authority failure and receipt lineage.

normative_requirement: Make the first bounded decision about whether and how much capital may proceed, using explicit serial eligibility, pre-deployment, PRL/final risk, capital state, policy, coefficients and temporal event context.
observed_code: Applies deterministic precedence: pre-deployment/risk blocks, serial no-trade, non-positive no-trade, max compression, coefficient floor, PRL caution and elevated event reduction, otherwise continue.
conformance_disposition: Decision precedence is clear, but no authoritative composer constructs the input from actual upstream owners and no capital-state transaction occurs.
gate_c_action: Prove owner-sourced input construction, mandatory IDs, precedence, fresh-capital semantics, no serial-confidence sizing and immutable receipt reproduction.

normative_requirement: Convert a capital decision into a non-executing protocol handoff preview only when authority is complete and positive.
observed_code: Requires capital receipt and candidate ID; blocks unless action CONTINUE and positive percentage/notional; otherwise builds order_intent_preview with execution_allowed false by contract.
conformance_disposition: Local fail-closed checks are appropriate. The seam is not connected to an authoritative candidate/capital state workflow.
gate_c_action: Prove missing receipt/candidate fails closed, no broker side effect, handoff identity/constraints, and future broker adapter substitution.

normative_requirement: Simulate broker order acknowledgement/fill/cancel/reject events behind a protocol-only boundary without live credentials or broker side effects.
observed_code: Creates deterministic paper records/events and maintains in-memory order lifecycle.
conformance_disposition: The current boundary correctly avoids live execution, but persistence/restart and exact integration with opening/inventory are incomplete.
gate_c_action: Prove protocol-only invariants, lifecycle idempotency, event ordering and adapter replacement without domain change.

normative_requirement: Read current position and capital state, calculate exposure, optionally normalise fill evidence, and emit a read-only inventory snapshot/receipt without changing serial decisions.
observed_code: Reads selected/all positions, reads capital snapshot, builds exposure state, optionally records inventory receipt; orchestrator may attach result read-only.
conformance_disposition: Read-only attachment is correct, but source repositories are process memory and state transitions are not atomically linked to execution receipts.
gate_c_action: Prove authoritative writer/readers, fill idempotency, restart persistence when admitted, and that inventory cannot alter serial outputs except through an explicit later contract.

normative_requirement: Evaluate whether an existing position should be held, trimmed or closed, then produce a non-executing handoff and replayable receipt.
observed_code: Applies bounded policy rules, builds decision, close handoff and receipt; replay currently returns a deterministic summary string from receipt fields.
conformance_disposition: Local policy and non-execution boundary exist, but authoritative input construction, durable state and fail-closed lineage are incomplete.
gate_c_action: Prove all required input IDs originate upstream, missing authority fails closed, policy version is carried and handoff cannot execute directly.

normative_requirement: Translate an exit/close decision into allowed overnight actions, evaluate market context within that ceiling, and compare the next session path without execution.
observed_code: Caps allowed actions from source exit state; recommends trim at >=4% above VWAP and close at VIX>=30, then caps by handoff; replay calculates open-gap and close-to-close percentages.
conformance_disposition: No execution authority is correctly enforced; thresholds and replay source lineage/version are not normatively grounded end-to-end.
gate_c_action: Prove action ceiling, no execution, threshold policy version, next-session source identity and deterministic replay.

normative_requirement: Record and retrieve daily P&L reports for review.
observed_code: Stores unique report IDs in memory and supports list/find by symbol/date.
conformance_disposition: Local uniqueness/read behaviour exists, but report correctness against positions/fills/capital and restart durability are unproved.
gate_c_action: Prove report derivation/reconciliation, source event IDs, duplicate/idempotent behaviour and explicit non-authoritative alpha status.

normative_requirement: Assemble review-safe execution, P&L and module-health material while redacting redirect/authority keys.
observed_code: Reads records/reports, deep-copies and recursively redacts selected keys, records missing material and builds review packet.
conformance_disposition: Review redaction and missing-material reporting are useful, but the underlying evidence is not durably preserved or transactionally complete.
gate_c_action: Prove redaction, explicit missing-material flags, packet/source lineage and no mutation/promotion of runtime authority.

normative_requirement: Explain a review packet by combining summary, resolved policy/coefficient surfaces and packet lineage without inventing missing evidence.
observed_code: Chooses resolved surfaces/coefficients, reports missing summary/surfaces/packet IDs, computes lineage_complete and deterministic text.
conformance_disposition: The service truthfully exposes missing evidence and avoids generating lineage. Its completeness claim is only as strong as supplied inputs.
gate_c_action: Preserve negative/missing-material tests and add origin validation at the upstream packet-lineage owner, not inside explanation text.

normative_requirement: Compare two bounded output mappings or review decisions without promoting replay results into runtime authority.
observed_code: Deep-copies mappings, lists differing/missing fields; citation replay checks missing decisions and emits promoted_to_runtime false.
conformance_disposition: It can compare supplied snapshots, but cannot reconstruct the original governed decision from durable inputs/config/state/output.
gate_c_action: Define the minimum replay envelope, then test reconstruction from retained authoritative artefacts; retain comparison utility as a subordinate tool.

normative_requirement: Rank or compare candidate stacks over supplied market rows for research/review only.
observed_code: Builds comparison summaries, ranks by score, supports simple walk-forward/fragility/batch wrappers and failure/bucket summaries.
conformance_disposition: The analysis path is bounded from runtime, but its name and wrappers exceed the simple current score comparison.
gate_c_action: Prove analysis-only boundary, dataset/window identity, deterministic ranking and no runtime promotion.

normative_requirement: Expose bounded runtime, configuration, calendar, risk, paper execution, review and analysis functions through one application shell.
observed_code: Constructs DTOs, delegates to services, and also stores some event lists and maps identifiers inside the API class.
conformance_disposition: Delegation exists, but one class owns unrelated API mapping, process state, fallback identity and private-repository access, so change impact is broad.
gate_c_action: Split tests by explicit application services/composition ports; prove API cannot invent domain authority or depend on private repository storage.
